Synonym of whatever floats your boat.
a small passerine bird in the wagtail family Motacillidae (Motacilla alba).

blocks.etymology: Inherited from Middle English wynsom, winsom, winsome, winsum, wunsum (“beautiful; agreeable, gracious, pleasant; generous; of situations: favourable, propitious”), from Old English wynsum (“joyful, merry, pleasant; winsome”), from Proto-West Germanic *wunnjusam (“joyful”). By surface analysis, winne (“delight, joy, pleasure”) + -some.
vi_block: Hấp dẫn, quyến rũ, lôi cuốn.
Vui vẻ, tưi tỉnh, rạng rỡ.

wiktionary.gloss: Charming, engaging, winning; inspiring approval and trust, especially if in an innocent manner.
